content.short: Hyward is a yield protocol operating on Hyperliquid.
content.description: Hyward runs an AI-driven auto-vote engine for ve(3,3) systems, deciding where a holder's votes go each epoch without manual input. Its vaults accumulate BTC and HYPE on autopilot from the emissions those votes capture. The product operates on HyperEVM.
content.meta: A yield protocol among the smaller but active deployments on Hyperliquid.
